items.title: Vigloo Studio: New AI Platform for Short-Form Microdramas
items.excerpt: Vigloo launched Vigloo Studio, an AI-native production platform built for creators of serialized short-form (microdrama) storytelling, consolidating fragmented pre-to-post workflows into a single environment for episodic drama creation. A concrete example of AI restructuring how short-form narrative content is produced end to end.

items.title: Expanding the VFX Playbook for Ted Season 2
items.excerpt: For Ted Season 2, the team blended AI, CG, real-time tools and digital environments, using Deep Voodoo's proprietary software to build a period-accurate Bill Clinton head replacement for Seth MacFarlane that captured speech and facial nuance beyond traditional CG. Shows how generative/AI face tools are entering mainstream episodic VFX pipelines.

items.title: Jamie Hearing on how Clear Angle is scanning the future of VFX
items.excerpt: Clear Angle Studios has become a key part of the modern VFX pipeline, capturing real-world actors and environments via LiDAR and Gaussian splats for teams to reconstruct in production. A look at how machine-learning-assisted scanning is reshaping on-set data capture for filmmakers and VFX artists.

items.title: SwitchHDR: an AI model for HDR reconstruction from SDR video
items.excerpt: Beeble unveiled SwitchHDR, an AI model that reconstructs HDR imagery from standard SDR video, outputting scene-linear 16-bit EXR sequences ready for professional HDR VFX and post pipelines. A workflow-changing tool that lets filmmakers pull legacy SDR footage into modern HDR grading and compositing.

items.title: Topaz Video - In Depth Review
items.excerpt: An in-depth review of Topaz Video, the AI upscaling and restoration tool (noise reduction, de-interlacing, stabilization) now on a subscription model following Adobe's acquisition of Topaz Labs. Details how AI upscaling/restoration fits into real filmmaker and archival workflows.
